[NDBG.9.2.1] The adapter's `initialize` response declares:

```json
{
  "supportsStepBack":                    true,
  "supportsRestartRequest":              true,
  "supportsGotoTargetsRequest":          true,
  "supportsStepInTargetsRequest":        true,
  "exceptionBreakpointFilters":          [ … ],
  "supportsFunctionBreakpoints":         true,
  "supportsDataBreakpoints":             false,
  "supportsConditionalBreakpoints":      true,
  "supportsHitConditionalBreakpoints":   true,
  "supportsLogPoints":                   true,
  "supportsRestartFrame":                false,
  "supportsSetVariable":                 false,
  "supportsCompletionsRequest":          false,
  "supportsEvaluateForHovers":           true,
  "additionalModuleColumns":             []
}
```

`exceptionBreakpointFilters` holds the three filters of [NDBG.12.6.1].
`supportsEvaluateForHovers` is what makes a client send the `evaluate` whose
`context` is `"hover"`, which [NDBG.13.7.1] serves.
